cases.title: Semantic Accessibility

input.request: Implement an accessible dialog and form flow.

cases.expected_output: Semantic roles, labels, focus entry/return, keyboard controls, and error announcements work.

success_criteria: Required outcome: Visual diff is reviewed at key breakpoints with intentional changes distinguished from regressions.
